# Generated branch

Every file on `pages-live` is generated by the Pages workflow from one commit
on `main`. Nothing here is written by hand.

- The workflow triggers only on `main` and manual dispatch, so pushing this
  branch never starts another publication.
- The next publication force-pushes this branch in full: an edit made here is
  lost without warning.
- The last verified game, screenshots, and screenshot history live here and
  nowhere else. They are carried forward by the workflow's assembly step when a
  build fails, so deleting this branch discards the visual history permanently.

The source that produces it is `.github/workflows/pages.yml` and `src/sitegen.rs`
on `main`.
